note: One persona point per case against the pieces it quotes. The label is applicability|trigger status, both decided by code from what the reading grounds (a trigger is supported only by a second quote from the same piece as the move; an evidence quote has three words at least unless the point's own quote is that short). The scope the reading gives is recorded beside each run as `aside` against the case's `aside`, and not judged: live evals of v1 and v2 put it at 7 of 12 cases and showed it is a judgement that moves between runs; nothing uses it until C5. A trigger that names a topic is forbidden by the prompt and not checkable by a label; it is read in the study.

point.description: When the accepted explanation hides the real constraint, opens the argument with the competing explanation and only then the mechanism, across the opening paragraphs.
point.quote: The usual story is that the queue is slow. It is not the queue.

pieces.name: piece-1
pieces.text:
Everyone on the team blamed the queue for the latency. The usual story is that the queue is slow. It is not the queue.

The lock on the writer is held across the network call, so every consumer waits on one socket.

Release the lock before the call.

pieces.name: piece-2
pieces.text:
The report shows the cache hit rate at ninety percent. That number counts hits on keys that are never read again.

Count hits on keys read within the hour, and the rate is forty.

pieces.name: piece-3
pieces.text: The deploy failed because the image tag moved. Pin the tag and the deploy is reproducible.
